description: Cinema interior, UPA flat. Observer in a seat, up-lit by screen glow, delighted
vo: You've seen it in movies a hundred times.

description: Hand raises a lighter beneath a sprinkler head, flame flickers, ominous
vo: Someone holds a lighter up to a sprinkler head.

description: Wide: every head on the ceiling bursts at once, full deluge, movie logic
vo: The entire building erupts in a wild torrent of water — every sprinkler head, all at once.

description: Observer soaked, papers flying past him, hero silhouette runs through spray
vo: Everyone is soaked, papers fly, and the hero escapes in the confusion.

description: Freeze frame; stamp lands over the still
vo: It's a wonderful scene.

description: Hard cut. Coral stamp. Colour drains out of the scene to paper
vo: It is also complete nonsense.

description: Wipe from paper to a real ceiling; camera settles
vo: Here is what actually happens.

description: Real ceiling: ONE head firing. Everything else dry and still
vo: One sprinkler head opens.

description: Push in on the single active head, directly above the fire
vo: That one. The one directly above the fire.

description: Slow pan across rows of sealed, dry heads. Nothing happening
vo: Every other head on that ceiling stays sealed, dry, and entirely uninterested.

description: Control-panel icon assembles, then is struck through
vo: Because there is no system. No panel deciding which heads to open.

description: Ceiling grid: each head resolves into an isolated node. No connecting lines are ever drawn
vo: Every head on that ceiling is its own separate machine, and

description: One node scales up, alone in frame
vo: each one knows precisely one thing:

description: Thermometer ring closes around the single node
vo: the temperature of the air immediately around it.

description: Top-down floorplan. Fire icon in one corner; heat gradient stays local
vo: A fire in the corner of an office is a local event, not a building-wide one.

description: Counter appears beside the active head
vo: And in a real fire, the usual number of heads that open is one.

description: Counter flickers to 2, settles back to 1
vo: Occasionally two.

description: Grid recedes; the question opens up
vo: So the question isn't how they all know.

description: Split comparison locks in
vo: It's what is inside that one, that isn't inside the other three hundred.

description: Corridor. Observer walks beneath the head and does not look up. Camera holds on the head after he exits
vo: Look up.

description: Macro: brass fitting, shallow focus, ordinary ceiling behind
vo: There it is: a small brass fitting

description: Same corridor, second pass. He walks under again. Still doesn't look
vo: you have walked underneath ten thousand times without once considering it.

description: Cutaway: ceiling tile peels back, pipe revealed above
vo: Above it, a pipe.

description: Water fills the pipe; pressure gauge swings
vo: Inside the pipe, water — at high pressure, directly over your head,

description: Date tick backwards to construction
vo: since the day the building went up.

description: Exploded view assembles
vo: Four parts.

description: Frame highlighted, screwed into the pipe
vo: A frame, screwed into the pipe.

description: Cap highlighted, sealing the opening
vo: A cap, sealing the opening.

description: Deflector disc highlighted; notches visible
vo: A deflector — that flat, notched disc on the bottom.

description: Compression arrows animate between cap and frame
vo: And wedged between the cap and the frame, under permanent compression,

description: Scale comparison beside the bulb
vo: a glass bulb about the size of a grain of rice.

description: Macro cutaway; liquid fills the bulb
vo: Inside the bulb: a glycerine-based liquid,

description: One air bubble appears inside the liquid, labelled
vo: and one small bubble of air.

description: Mechanism clock starts. Beat before the fire
vo: That's the trigger. Now watch it work.

description: Office. Observer at a desk, back turned. Waste bin catches fire behind him
vo: A bin ignites.

description: Smoke curls up past his shoulder. He does not notice
vo: Smoke rises — and does nothing at all.

description: Nose icon struck through
vo: Sprinklers cannot smell.

description: Thermometer confirms
vo: They react to heat, and only heat.

description: Hot gas plume spreads flat across the ceiling plane
vo: The hot gas spreads out across the ceiling and

description: Plume reaches the nearest head node
vo: reaches the nearest head.

description: Macro: liquid expands inside the bulb
vo: The liquid in the bulb begins to expand.

description: The bubble shrinks
vo: The bubble shrinks.

description: Countdown ticks
vo: Ten seconds. Twenty.

description: Bubble gone. Liquid pressed hard against the glass
vo: The bubble is gone now, the liquid has nowhere left to go, and the

description: Macro hero: intact bulb under visible strain, light stressing through it
vo: glass is holding —

description: Observer beat — unimpressed by how stubborn glass is
vo: because glass, it turns out, is remarkably stubborn.

description: Hard suspense beat. Everything stops
vo: Until it isn't.

description: Slow-mo: the bulb shatters from the inside, shards outward
vo: The bulb shatters from the inside.

description: The cap drops away
vo: The cap drops away.

description: Water released; the wait counter zeroes
vo: The water, which has been waiting patiently for about thirty years, leaves —

description: Water strikes the deflector and breaks into a full cone of spray
vo: strikes the deflector, breaks into a cone of spray,

description: Exponential fire curve climbing, doubling every half minute
vo: and the fire, which had been roughly doubling in size every half minute,

description: Curve snaps flat the instant water lands
vo: stops doubling.

description: Observer stands under the DRY neighbouring head, looking across at the wet one
vo: Two metres away, the next head sits in the cool air doing absolutely nothing.

description: Held. Nothing happens. He waits
vo: It will still be doing nothing

description: Fire brigade arrive. Exterior, UPA flat
vo: when the fire brigade arrives.

description: Checklist opens
vo: And that is the whole mechanism.

onscreen: No sensor · No wiring · No computer
description: Items strike in one at a time
vo: No sensor. No wiring. No computer.

onscreen: No control panel · No decision of any kind
description: Final items settle
vo: No control panel. No decision of any kind.

description: Return to the macro bubble; it shrinks to nothing. Pull wide to a calm building
vo: A bubble got smaller, and a building got saved.

description: Swatch row assembles across the frame
vo: Now — those bulbs are colour-coded, because of course they are.

description: Orange swatch expands, chip sets
vo: Orange opens at fifty-seven degrees.

description: Red swatch
vo: Red at sixty-eight.

description: Yellow swatch
vo: Yellow, seventy-nine.

description: Green swatch
vo: Green, ninety-three.

description: Three high swatches added, chips smaller
vo: Then blue, purple and black,

description: Boiler room / commercial kitchen ceiling, heat haze — where 200 °F is an ordinary Tuesday
vo: for rooms where ninety-three degrees is considered a normal Tuesday.

description: Type beat over the cooling swatch row
vo: And that colour is not a setting.

description: Observer AS INSTALLER. Tray of coloured bulbs. He picks one up, weighs it
vo: It's a judgement. Somebody had to choose the bulb for the room.

description: Commercial kitchen: an office-rated head directly above a deep fryer, steam rising
vo: Put an office-rated head above a deep fat fryer

description: It trips at lunchtime. Staff unimpressed, water over the pass
vo: and it opens every lunchtime.

description: Quiet office. Oversized industrial-rated head on the ceiling
vo: Put a kitchen-rated head in a quiet office and the room

description: A small fire smoulders below it. The head stays shut
vo: can be well alight before it notices anything unusual.

description: Installer on a stepladder, looking around the empty room, guessing
vo: So somewhere, years ago, a person had to guess how hot your ceiling gets on an ordinary day —

description: He packs up, walks out, the door closes. Empty room. The head above
vo: and then leave.

description: Head greys out and locks
vo: And when one does finally go, it doesn't reset.

description: Toggle icon struck through
vo: There's no switch. That head is finished.

description: Technician arrives with a spanner
vo: Somebody arrives with a spanner,

description: Hands screw in the replacement head, close on the thread
vo: screws in a new one,

description: New head settles. The wait restarts from zero
vo: and the new one starts waiting too.

description: Comparison chart opens
vo: As for the water damage everybody worries about — a sprinkler head

vo: puts out somewhere around sixty litres a minute.

description: Firehose bar dwarfs it, runs off frame
vo: A firefighter's hose puts out ten to twenty times that.

description: Inversion lands
vo: The sprinkler isn't the flood. The sprinkler is what prevents the flood.

description: Pull back to the full ceiling grid; every head a separate dot
vo: So the ceiling above you is not one system.

description: Dots pulse individually, out of phase. No lines between them
vo: It's several hundred entirely separate ones,

description: One dot glows
vo: each with its own small glass fuse,

description: Camera drifts across inert dots, minding their own business
vo: each minding its own business, none of them talking to each other.

description: Type over the empty grid
vo: Nothing up there is watching you.

description: Grid fades toward paper
vo: Nothing is deciding anything.

description: Macro: the glass bulb, rim light, pressure implied behind it
vo: It is a piece of glass,

description: Slow push-in. Droplet tension on the surface
vo: holding back a river, waiting for something to get warm.

description: Observer looks up. Hold on him, not the ceiling. Fade
vo: Look up. It's still there.
